## Overview

MarkdStage v4.6.3 makes the production Canvas Extension distribution small enough for
GitHub Copilot's folder-install limit. Large vendor assets are stored as integrity-checked
gzip chunks in the generated distribution, while the canonical Extension source remains
available for development. This release includes the changes from [PR #275](https://github.com/runceel/MarkdStage/pull/275).

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible. Existing Markdown decks, CLI arguments, and the VS Code
integration protocol do not require changes.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.6.3`. |
